The lens is wide-angle, capturing the shallow depth of field where the apple occupies the central plane while the background dissolves into a warm, dusty bokeh of muted browns and greens. A single key light source from the upper left casts long shadows across the textured wood grain, emphasizing the organic sheen of the fruit's skin and the subtle imperfections in its form. The lighting creates a rich contrast between the cool highlights on the apple's surface and the warm tones of the surroundings, evoking an intimate stillness that feels both natural and cinematic. A fine layer of atmospheric haze softens the edges slightly, enhancing the sense of depth and placing the subject firmly within its quiet, sun-dappled environment.","duration":9.44}
